The 579-MCP1407-E/SN is the Mouser part number for the Microchip Technology MCP1407-E/SN, a high-speed, 6A low-side power MOSFET gate driver.

Key Specifications

• Manufacturer: Microchip Technology
• Part Number / MPN: MCP1407-E/SN (Mouser Stock No: 579-MCP1407-E/SN)
• Package / Case: 8-pin SOIC (SOIC-8)
• Mounting Style: Surface Mount (SMD / SMT)
• Number of Drivers: 1 Driver (Single Output)
• Peak Output / Sink / Source Current: 6A
• Operating Voltage Range: 4.5V to 18V
• Rise / Fall Times: ~20 ns (driving 2500 pF load)
• Operating Temperature Range: -40°C to +125°C
